title: SE implementation scratchpad - Harbor Trust Bank
content:
Context:
- Customer: Harbor Trust Bank (regional, financial services). Wants Private deployment (VPC) with dedicated capacity and HSM integration for keys. Compliance: SOC2 + regional privacy. Primary use: document summarization and internal knowledge retrieval for branch employees.

High-level goals:
- Private control plane in customer VPC (managed connector).
- Dedicated GPU pool for production inference (low latency, predictable throughput).
- KMS/HSM for key management and audit logging.
- SAML SSO + SCIM for user provisioning.
- Network peering with bank network (restricted egress rules).

Recent calls / decisions:
- 2026-02-15: Security review accepted POC architecture (pending final network ACLs).
- 2026-02-19: Harbor IT validated HSM vendor (Thales). Need KMS integration checklist.
- 2026-02-20: Performance targets: p50 latency <= 120ms for 512-token responses, sustained 45 reqs/s with autoscale.

Open questions for customer (owner: Liam):
- Confirm CIDR ranges for peering and any blacklisted IP ranges. (HTB IT)
- Which subnets are available for dedicated instances? Private vs public?
- Does Harbor want outbound-only NAT or full egress controls? List of allowed endpoints needed.

Action items / TODOs:
- [ ] (Samira) Draft final network diagram with exact subnets and expected NAT rules - due 2026-02-24.
- [ ] (Liam) Share SAML metadata and ACS URLs for Redwood Console SSO - due 2026-02-23.
- [ ] (Maya) Prepare HSM/KMS integration runbook and test harness for key wrap/unwrap flows - due 2026-02-28.
- [ ] (Jasper) Validate model quantization profile for their 8GB GPU SKU to meet latency targets - due 2026-02-26.
- [ ] (Samira) Create canary rollout plan for 2-week ramp with fallback to hosted model cache.

Network / infra notes (raw):
- Proposed VPC: vpc-htb-01 (10.140.0.0/16) - need to confirm.
- Dedicated subnets: private-subnet-a (10.140.1.0/24), private-subnet-b (10.140.2.0/24). Place inference nodes in private-subnets only.
- Peering: Create VPC peering to HTB-core-vpc (10.10.0.0/16). Route table entries: 10.10.0.0/16 -> peering-rt.
- NAT: prefer customer-managed NAT gateway. If Redwood-managed, must lock down to allowed endpoints: telemetry.redwood-inference.com:443, registry.redwood-inference.com:443, time sync NTP.
- Egress policy: block all except listed endpoints and KMS/HSM vendor endpoints.

Security / keys:
- HSM vendor: Thales Luna (customer provided). Need KMS connector details + service account.
- Key rotation policy: customer wants monthly rotation; confirm with security.
- Audit: enable detailed audit logs (syslog forward to customer SIEM).

Identity / SSO:
- SAML attributes requested: email, name, groups, employee_id.
- SCIM: enable provisioning with group sync (teams: support, infra, app-dev).
- Session timeout: align with Harbor policy (30 min).

Model / Runtime notes:
- Model family: open-llm/robin-13b (customer selected open model). Quantization target: 4-bit (Q4) to fit on 8GB instances.
- Inference nodes: target 8GB A10x or equivalent (customer-specified). Need perf bench.
- KV cache: enable per-tenant prefix caching for common doc prefixes (saves tokens).
- Fallback: configure hosted lightweight model (robin-1.3b) for capacity failures.

Testing / validation plan:
1) Network connectivity smoke: ping to endpoints, TLS handshake to registry + telemetry.
2) SAML login + SCIM provisioning test users.
3) KMS/HSM wrap/unwrap test with test key and audit verify.
4) Perf bench: run 1,000 synthetic requests (512 tokens) to verify p50/p90 and throughput.
5) Security scan: container image SBOM + vulnerability quick-scan.

Canary / rollout plan (high level):
- Phase 0: internal staging with sample data (1 day).
- Phase 1: Canary (5% traffic, 48 hours) - monitor latency, error rates, cost burn.
- Phase 2: Gradual ramp 20% -> 50% over 1 week.
- Phase 3: Full cutover if metrics stable for 72 hours.
- Fallback: automatic switch to hosted model variant if error rate > 1% or p90 > 500ms for 10 minutes.

Risks / mitigations:
- Risk: HSM connectivity failure in production -> Mitigation: use encrypted KMS fallback (customer approved) and maintain strict alerting.
- Risk: Quantized model quality regression -> Mitigation: run prompt-evals set; hold rollout until regression < 2% on core metrics.
- Risk: Network ACLs too restrictive -> Mitigation: early coordination call with Harbor networking; share required endpoints list.

Notes from last onsite (2026-02-10):
- Harbor asked about local logging retention (retain logs 1 year). Need pricing impact for extended retention. (Follow-up finance).
- Ops wants a runbook with step-by-step to failover to hosted stack. I should draft this.

Attachments to generate for next sync:
- Network diagram (Samira)
- HSM integration runbook (Maya)
- Perf bench results template (Jasper)
- Canary monitoring dashboard template (Samira)

Next meeting scheduled: 2026-02-25 10:00 AM HTB / Redwood sync (agenda: finalize subnets, SAML metadata, HSM creds).

Quick notes / scratch ideas:
- Consider using prefix caching TTL of 12h for internal docs to balance staleness cost.
- Add an eval job: daily small-sample generation check to monitor drift (hooks to Alerts).
- If they need stricter latency, propose 12GB instance SKU or reduce batch window to 10ms (cost tradeoff).

Log of edits:
- 2025-11-12: initial note (Samira)
- 2026-01-08: added model target + perf goals (Jasper)
- 2026-02-15: security review notes added (Maya)
- 2026-02-19: HSM vendor confirmed (Samira)
- 2026-02-22: updated rollout thresholds and meeting time (Samira)

-- end of scratchpad --
